LIVE_VALUE.description: Value detected live during the match.

CONSENSUS.description: Several independent strategies converge on the same pick.

RESULT_BTTS.description: Match result combined with both teams to score.

WIN_TO_NIL.description: A team wins the match without conceding.

HALF_TIME_FULL_TIME.description: Half-time result combined with the final result.

VANTAGE.description: Reads every other channel's decision and its observed calibration in this competition; only proposes a pick when it finds a concrete tension between them.

reasons.below_conviction: No scoreline confident enough to predict
reasons.VANTAGE_GATED_ODDS: Read kept but not proposed: odds above 1.80
reasons.VANTAGE_GATED_MARKET: Read kept but not proposed: recently unreliable bet type

avoid.tooltipDetail: One of the picks below has too large a gap between the model's probability and the market's implied probability (≥ 30 points). Historically the market is right in this case — spot the pick flagged ⚠ and skip it, the others remain valid.
avoid.edgeTooltip: Model/market divergence: {pct} — this pick triggered the Caution signal

calibration.tooltipDetail: The model and the market strongly disagree on this match (flipped favorite or extreme gap across several bookmakers). This almost always signals corrupted input data, not an opportunity: the match is removed from all our coupons and from the home picks. Predictions stay visible for reading; on these matches, above 1.45, our percentages are clearly too optimistic.
calibration.badgeTooltip: {status, select, GREEN {In this competition, this channel wins about as often as it announces} ORANGE {In this competition, this channel wins noticeably less — or more — often than it announces} RED {In this competition, this channel's actual hit rate is far from what it announces: handle with care} other {Not enough volume in this competition}} ({n, plural, one {# settled pick} other {# settled picks}} over 90 days).

consensus.tooltipDetail: Several independent channels selected the same outcome without coordinating. It is an agreement, not a guarantee: CONSENSUS no longer emits a pick or a probability of its own — the one it used to publish was the maximum across the agreeing channels, and therefore optimistic by construction.

arbitrage.title: AI opinion
arbitrage.description: Reads every other channel's decision and its observed calibration in this competition. A pick is retained only when a concrete disagreement is found; no pick is a normal outcome.

updates.title: Announcements
updates.subtitle: History of announcements published by the EVCore team.

welcome.title: Welcome to EVCore
welcome.description: A full tour of the app's pages and tools. Close it anytime — you can always replay it from your profile menu.

mobileNav.title: The full menu
mobileNav.description: On mobile, this button opens the full navigation menu — every section is there, even the ones that don't fit the bottom bar.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Every match of the day, with what each channel thinks. The "?" button here explains how to read a pick anytime.

fixtures.title: Matches
fixtures.description: Every match of the day, filterable by status. The betting index gives you the key stats at a glance.

arbitrage.title: AI opinion
arbitrage.description: VANTAGE, our AI channel, only proposes a bet when it spots a real disagreement between the other channels — never just to confirm what they already say. The "?" here details its logic.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.description: Combos generated automatically from admissible picks. The "?" opens calibration measures for the channels being combined.

betSlipComposer.title: My bet slip
betSlipComposer.description: Build your own bet slip by adding picks from Decisions — this button follows you everywhere in the app.

betSlips.title: My bet slips
betSlips.description: Your history of placed bet slips — settled or pending — with the period summary up top.

bankroll.title: Stake tracking
bankroll.description: Your balance, deposits and withdrawals as you enter them: the real record of what you stake.

trackRecord.title: Historical measures
trackRecord.description: What our predictions actually delivered: announced and realised, by odds and by channel, losses included.

formation.title: Training
formation.description: Short articles on betting strategy — implied probabilities, unit staking, variance, channels. Browse at your own pace.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: A direct line to the EVCore team for your questions or feedback.

evaFab.title: Eva
evaFab.description: Generates and exports the sheet of retained picks over a period (txt/json) — handy for archiving or sharing it. Long-press to hide it.

pageSearchFab.title: Search this page
pageSearchFab.description: Search text directly on the current page — handy on a long list of matches. Hidden by default, long-press to hide it again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Performance alerts and team announcements show up here — always reachable, wherever you are in the app.

accountMenu.title: Your profile menu
accountMenu.description: Stake tracking, Inbox, Training and Settings: everything we just covered is also reachable from here.

profileBadges.title: Profile and badges
profileBadges.description: Your profile and the badges you unlock by learning: training completed, reading probabilities.

accountSettings.title: Settings
accountSettings.description: Appearance, language, notifications, bankroll preferences and security — all set from these tabs.

homeCoupon.title: Today's coupon
homeCoupon.description: Everything starts here: today's proposed coupon, its legs and its odds. “Play this coupon” adds it to your slip.

homePicks.title: Today's picks
homePicks.description: Five picks at most, taken from reliable channels within the odds band where the measure holds. The + adds them to your coupon.

homeMySlips.title: Your coupons
homeMySlips.description: What you played: pending, won, hit rate. The My coupons page details every slip.

formation.label: Training
formation.title: Training center
formation.subtitle: Articles and videos to understand each pick and improve step by step.
